dishes.name: Bötel mit Lehm und Stroh
dishes.desc: Boiled pork knuckle with pea purée and sauerkraut. The purée is the clay and the sauerkraut the straw. Found at Magdeburg old-town inns.

dishes.name: Bollwurst
dishes.desc: Spreadable cooked pork sausage seasoned with onions, from the Magdeburger Börde. Eaten on bread.

dishes.name: Pottsuse
dishes.desc: Pork and lard spread with spices, a traditional farmhouse spread from the Börde. Eaten on dark bread.

dishes.name: Salzwedeler Baumkuchen
dishes.desc: Layered cake baked on a rotating spit, built up ring by ring. Salzwedel in the Altmark is its traditional home.

dishes.name: Grützwurst with red cabbage
dishes.desc: Sausage of groats and pork, served with apple red cabbage. Altmark winter dish.
